rows.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : α → β → m α), Array.foldlM f a o.toArray = o.elim (pure a) fun b => f a b

rows.name: core_Option_foldrM_toList
rows.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : β → α → m α), List.foldrM f a o.toList = o.elim (pure a) fun b => f b a

rows.name: core_Option_foldr_toArray
rows.statement: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} (o : Option β) (a : α) (f : β → α → α), Array.foldr f a o.toArray = o.elim a fun b => f b a

rows.name: core_Option_forIn_some
rows.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (a : α) (b : β) (f : α → β → m (ForInStep β)), forIn (some a) b f = do let r ← f a b pure r.value

rows.name: core_Option_forM_some
rows.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] (f : α → m PUnit) (a : α), forM (some a) f = f a

rows.name: core_Option_getDM_some
rows.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Pure m] (a : α) (y : m α), (some a).getDM y = pure a

rows.name: core_Option_getD_guard
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {a b : α}, (Option.guard p a).getD b = if p a = true then a else b

rows.name: core_Option_get_bind
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {x : Option α} {f : α → Option β} (h : (x.bind f).isSome = true), (x.bind f).get h = (f (x.get ⋯)).get ⋯

rows.name: core_Option_get_of_mem
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {o : Option α} (h : o.isSome = true), a ∈ o → o.get h = a

rows.name: core_Option_get_pmap
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Bool} {f : (x : α) → p x = true → β} {o : Option α} {h : ∀ (a : α), o = some a → p a = true} {h' : (Option.pmap f o h).isSome = true}, (Option.pmap f o h).get h' = f (o.get ⋯) ⋯

rows.name: core_Option_guard_true
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, (Option.guard fun x => true) = some

rows.name: core_Option_instLawfulIdentityOrNone
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, Std.LawfulIdentity Option.or none

rows.name: core_Option_isSome_iff_exists
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : Option α}, x.isSome = true ↔ ∃ a, x = some a

rows.name: core_Option_isSome_of_isSome_bind
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {x : Option α} {f : α → Option β}, (x.bind f).isSome = true → x.isSome = true

rows.name: core_Option_isSome_of_isSome_pbind
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {o : Option α} {f : (a : α) → o = some a → Option β}, (o.pbind f).isSome = true → o.isSome = true

rows.name: core_Option_isSome_unattach
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {o : Option { x // p x }}, o.unattach.isSome = o.isSome

rows.name: core_Option_join_ne_none'
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : Option (Option α)}, ¬x.join = none ↔ ∃ z, x = some (some z)

rows.name: core_Option_mapM_some
rows.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Applicative m] (x : α) (f : α → m β), Option.mapM f (some x) = some <$> f x

rows.name: core_Option_map_congr
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {α_1 : Type u_2} {f g : α → α_1} {x : Option α}, (∀ (a : α), x = some a → f a = g a) → Option.map f x = Option.map g x

rows.name: core_Option_mem_dite_none_right
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : Prop} {x : α} {x_1 : Decidable p} {l : p → Option α}, (x ∈ if h : p then l h else none) ↔ ∃ h, x ∈ l h

rows.name: core_Option_mem_some_self
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : α), a ∈ some a

rows.name: core_Option_min_filter_right
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Min α] [Std.IdempotentOp min] {p : α → Bool} {o : Option α}, min o (Option.filter p o) = Option.filter p o

rows.name: core_Option_min_some_some
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Min α] {a b : α}, min (some a) (some b) = some (min a b)

rows.name: core_Option_not_isNone
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : Option α), (!a.isNone) = a.isSome

rows.name: core_Option_not_mem_none
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : α), ¬a ∈ none

rows.name: core_Option_pelim_guard
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {β : Sort u_2} {b : β} {a : α} {f : (a' : α) → Option.guard p a = some a' → β}, (Option.guard p a).pelim b f = if h : p a = true then f a ⋯ else b

rows.name: core_Option_pfilter_join
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option (Option α)} {p : (a : α) → o.join = some a → Bool}, o.join.pfilter p = (o.pfilter fun o' h => o'.pelim false fun a ha => p a ⋯).join

rows.name: core_Option_pure_apply
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α}, pure x = some x

rows.name: core_Option_sequence_some
rows.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Applicative m] (f : m α), (some f).sequence = some <$> f

rows.name: core_Option_size_toArray_le
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option α}, o.toArray.size ≤ 1

rows.name: core_Option_toArray_pfilter
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option α} {p : (a : α) → o = some a → Bool}, (o.pfilter p).toArray = (Array.filter (fun x => p x.val ⋯) o.toArray.attach).unattach

rows.name: core_Option_toList_filter
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option α} {p : α → Bool}, (Option.filter p o).toList = List.filter p o.toList

rows.name: core_Option_toList_join
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option (Option α)}, o.join.toList = List.flatMap Option.toList o.toList

rows.name: core_Option_unattach_filter
rows.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {o : Option { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → Bool} {g : α → Bool}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x), f ⟨x, h⟩ = g x) → (Option.filter f o).unattach = Option.filter g o.unattach
